name: Paritranaya Sadhunam (Bhagavad Gita 4.8)
text:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् ।
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥
meaning: To protect those who act rightly, restrain destructive actions and restore balance, I appear age after age.
purpose: A verse on protection and the restoration of ethical order.
supports: Courage; responsibility; hope during difficult times.
when: When seeking strength to act in accordance with values.
